//include: The items themselves stay in `apps/site`, next to the site that builds and serves them at blobatar.dev/r/. This file exists only because shadcn's GitHub resolver looks for a `registry.json` at the repository root and nowhere else; `include` paths are resolved relative to the file that declares them, so `registry/blobatar.tsx` still means `apps/site/registry/blobatar.tsx` and nothing had to move.
